# WO-2026-08-10-09 — One question surface Warwick can actually read
# guidance: WO-YYYY-MM-DD-nn — slice title

## Acceptance criteria

### What Warwick actually got, and what Veritas said about it

He received **EIGHT independent Telegram question cards** for one shop. He could not tell what he
had answered, what remained, or whether anything still blocked the shop. **Larry had to query the
database and tell him "6 of 8".** Veritas Gate 2 returned **FAIL** and named the cause from source:

> `lines_unresolved` is gated behind `outboxEverQueued(deps, shop.id, 'lines_unresolved')`
> (`runPipeline.js:1009`) — **sent at most ONCE per shop, never refreshed**, its counts stale the
> moment he answers anything. **He received none for M64.** No other surface reports answered
> versus outstanding at all.

> *"Larry having to query the database to tell him '6 of 8' is, by itself, the answer to this
> gate's question."*

**The raw capture of what he received is at `Deliverables/2026-08-10-warwick-telegram-capture-m64.md`.
Read it before designing anything.** It is his own verbatim paste, not Larry's account.

### Acceptance criteria

**AC1 — ONE COHERENT SURFACE, not N independent cards.** Every currently unresolved question for a
shop is visible together, in one place Warwick can look at, rather than scattered through
scrollback. The SHAPE is yours to propose at read-back — Telegram supports editing a message in
place, which is the obvious primitive — but the property is not negotiable: **he must be able to
see the whole outstanding set at once.**

**AC2 — ANSWERED vs OUTSTANDING IS VISIBLE FROM THE PRODUCT.** He can tell which questions he has
answered, **what the accepted answer was**, and which remain. Not from scrollback, not from Larry,
not from the database.

**AC3 — IT REFRESHES AS ANSWERS LAND.** A once-ever card whose counts go stale on the first answer
is the defect Gate 2 failed on; do not rebuild it. State must be current when he looks at it.

**AC4 — HE CAN TELL WHEN NOTHING IS BLOCKING.** The product says, in its own voice, that the shop
is unblocked — or what is still holding it. **`READY_TO_SHOP` must never be reached while an
unresolved question remains**, and reaching it must be visible to him without interpretation.

**AC5 — INTERNALLY COHERENT PRESENTATION.** Candidates, suggestions, uncertainty and the required
action must agree with each other. Never *"No candidate products found"* beside suggestions —
WP-B15-08 fixed that on the old card; it must hold on whatever you build. **Never render a control
the system will refuse** (WP-B15-08 AC10); **never render a control that appears actionable and
does nothing.**

**AC6 — A REFUSAL IN OUR NAMESPACE REACHES WARWICK. This is a MISS in WP-B15-08 and it is yours to
finish.** Veritas D-2, verified by Larry: `runtime.js:591-594` pushes the refusal into the pass
report and `continue`s **without calling `acknowledge`** — the only thing that puts text on his
phone (compare `:645`, which does call it). Its own comment says *"the only record was a journal
line he will never read"* and then writes to a journal. **Journal to pass-report is journal to
journal.** A refused tap in the `asd:` namespace must be visible to the human who tapped it.
Note the known constraint: a Telegram callback answer expires ("query is too old"); if the toast
cannot be relied on, say so and use a route that survives.

**AC7 — STALE CONTROLS.** Cards already sitting in his chat still carry buttons withdrawn since.
You cannot un-send them; make pressing one produce an honest, visible response rather than silence.

**AC8 — A REPLY TO AN ALREADY-ANSWERED CARD IS NOT A SHOPPING LIST.** Named residual from
WP-B15-08: with no open questions the claim is never built, so the message reaches intake and
becomes a shop. Claiming without recording would be the silent drop Keel correctly refused; the
answer is to tell him what happened. **A list must still never be silently dropped.**

**AC9 — REGRESSIONS FIRST.** Every AC gets a test that FAILS against current behaviour before your
fix exists, quoted RED then GREEN.

**AC10 — NOTHING WRITTEN TO THE LIVE STORE.** `live_authority: none`. `SHOP-2026-08-10-M64` is now
**EVIDENCE of the failure and must be preserved untouched** — Warwick has ruled that acceptance
will be a CLEAN journey, not a rescue of that shop. Do not connect to the live database.

## Required evidence

- `cd services/asdair/pipeline && node --test` -> PASS/FAIL COUNTS before and after (baseline 405)
- `cd services/asdair/bot && node --test` -> counts before and after (baseline 170)
- `cd services/asdair/shop && node --test` -> counts before and after (baseline 102)
- `cd services/asdair/intake && node --test` -> counts before and after (baseline 34)
- every new regression run in BOTH directions, RED before the fix and GREEN after, each with its executed count quoted

Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass

## Explicitly out of scope — report, never fix

- `runPipeline.js`, `deps.js` and the control-plane command surface — **WP-B15-10's worker owns those.** If the once-ever gate at `runPipeline.js:1009` must change, SAY SO and I will route it; do not edit it.
- Match quality and unnecessary questions — WP-B15-10.
- Pack-size / quantity parsing and the intake CLI — WP-B15-11.
- Durable household learning from free text — a separate order; do not half-build it here.
- Repairing `SHOP-2026-08-10-M64`. It is preserved evidence.

## Sequencing

1. **READ-BACK FIRST, then HOLD** (SOP-022). Restate the outcome, your PROPOSED SURFACE SHAPE,
   what the order failed to settle, and what looks wrong. The properties are settled by Warwick;
   the design is yours to propose and I will accept or amend it.
2. Baselines for all four suites.
3. Regressions RED first, then build.
4. AC6 is a correction of work that shipped tonight — do it early; it is small and visible.
N-2. Mutation-prove each guard you add. Mutate inside a `git archive` export or restore in a
   `finally`; assert the source ACTUALLY CHANGED before running, and assert byte-identical restore.
N-1. Re-run all four suites; report counts.
N. **Git endpoint: COMMIT and PUSH your own branch. No PR. Do NOT touch `main`. Do NOT merge.**
   Larry integrates, cuts the runtime over and commissions Veritas.

Return: what you changed and why, both mutation directions with sha256 pairs, suite counts,
anything you refused and why, and any finding you are reporting rather than fixing.

⚠️ THREE WORKERS ARE RUNNING IN PARALLEL ON DISJOINT SURFACES. Do not edit a file outside your
`file_surface` even if you can see the defect there — report it and I will route it. If your fix
genuinely requires a file another worker owns, STOP and return that conclusion; a silent
cross-surface edit corrupts a parallel branch.
